scope: The 11 bundled Artvee images in Shape & Colour; provider terms and Australian term assessment, not unrestricted worldwide clearance.

providerTerms.summary: Artvee permits downloading, sharing and reusing these public-domain images without added usage restrictions, including commercial projects.

worldwideStatus: Not certified. Territory-specific terms and publication history can differ; provider permissions do not establish ownership of every possible underlying right.
